mapper.insert: insert into complaint ( member_id, title, content, complaint_type, priority, status, station_id, charger_id, station_name, charger_name, notify_email, notify_sms, notify_site, created_at ) values ( #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{complaintType}, #{priority}, '접수', #{stationId}, #{chargerId}, #{stationName}, #{chargerName}, #{notifyEmail}, #{notifySms}, #{notifySite}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select c.complaint_id as complaintId, c.member_id as memberId, c.title, c.content, c.complaint_type as complaintType, c.priority, c.status, c.station_id as stationId, c.charger_id as chargerId, c.station_name as stationName, c.charger_name as chargerName, c.notify_email as notifyEmail, c.notify_sms as notifySms, c.notify_site as notifySite, c.assigned_department_id as assignedDepartmentId, d.department_name as assignedDepartmentName, c.assigned_employee_id as assignedEmployeeId, am.member_name as assignedEmployeeName, c.ai_summary as aiSummary, c.admin_memo as adminMemo, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt, c.closed_at as closedAt from complaint c left join department d on c.assigned_department_id = d.department_id left join employee e on c.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member am on e.member_id = am.member_id where c.member_id = #{memberId} order by c.created_at desc

select c.complaint_id as complaintId, c.member_id as memberId, m.member_name as memberName, m.user_id as userId, m.email, m.phone, c.title, c.content, c.complaint_type as complaintType, c.priority, c.status, c.station_id as stationId, c.charger_id as chargerId, c.station_name as stationName, c.charger_name as chargerName, c.notify_email as notifyEmail, c.notify_sms as notifySms, c.notify_site as notifySite, c.assigned_department_id as assignedDepartmentId, d.department_name as assignedDepartmentName, c.assigned_employee_id as assignedEmployeeId, am.member_name as assignedEmployeeName, c.ai_summary as aiSummary, c.admin_memo as adminMemo, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt, c.closed_at as closedAt from complaint c join app_member m on c.member_id = m.member_id left join department d on c.assigned_department_id = d.department_id left join employee e on c.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member am on e.member_id = am.member_id where c.member_id = #{memberId} and c.complaint_id = #{complaintId}

select c.complaint_id as complaintId, c.member_id as memberId, m.member_name as memberName, m.user_id as userId, m.email, m.phone, c.title, c.content, c.complaint_type as complaintType, c.priority, c.status, c.station_id as stationId, c.charger_id as chargerId, c.station_name as stationName, c.charger_name as chargerName, c.notify_email as notifyEmail, c.notify_sms as notifySms, c.notify_site as notifySite, c.assigned_department_id as assignedDepartmentId, d.department_name as assignedDepartmentName, c.assigned_employee_id as assignedEmployeeId, am.member_name as assignedEmployeeName, c.ai_summary as aiSummary, c.admin_memo as adminMemo, c.created_at as createdAt, c.updated_at as updatedAt, c.closed_at as closedAt from complaint c join app_member m on c.member_id = m.member_id left join department d on c.assigned_department_id = d.department_id left join employee e on c.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member am on e.member_id = am.member_id where c.complaint_id = #{complaintId}

select h.history_id as historyId, h.complaint_id as complaintId, h.employee_id as employeeId, m.member_name as employeeName, h.before_status as beforeStatus, h.after_status as afterStatus, h.action_type as actionType, h.memo, h.created_at as createdAt from complaint_history h left join employee e on h.employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id where h.complaint_id = #{complaintId} order by h.created_at asc
mapper.update: update complaint set status = #{status}, admin_memo = coalesce(#{adminMemo}, admin_memo), updated_at = current_timestamp, closed_at = case when #{closed} = true then current_timestamp else closed_at end where complaint_id = #{complaintId}
update complaint set assigned_department_id = #{assignedDepartmentId}, assigned_employee_id = #{assignedEmployeeId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where complaint_id = #{complaintId}
mapper.insert: insert into complaint_history ( complaint_id, employee_id, before_status, after_status, action_type, memo, created_at ) values ( #{complaintId}, #{employeeId}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{actionType}, #{memo}, current_timestamp )
mapper.select: select employee_id from employee where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
